case_title: Sardar Ali Khan v. The State of Uttar Pradesh through Principal Secretary Home Department & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused purchased a plot by sale deed dated 29 December 1993, which was registered on 5 January 1994. The father of the second respondent died in December 1997. The second respondent filed a civil suit in 2008 seeking cancellation of the sale deed. In 2012, the second respondent filed a criminal complaint against the accused, alleging forgery and impersonation. The civil suit was pending, and the court held that the second respondent could not pursue criminal proceedings for the same issue, as it was a civil matter. The court quashed the criminal proceedings, finding it an abuse of the process of law.
